# Triplanio

> Plan your whole trip in one place: timeline, map, budget and bookings, with an AI agent that reads your confirmations. Free to start, no card.

Triplanio is a web app for planning multi-city trips and sharing the costs of them. A trip holds its cities and dates, a day-by-day timeline, the route on a map, every booking, the budget in any currency, and the travel documents — all in one place, for one traveller or a whole group. An AI agent reads forwarded booking confirmations and files them into the trip; a Telegram assistant answers questions about the itinerary while you are on the road.

This file is written for AI agents and answer engines. The public pages listed below are served as ready HTML — their text is in the document, no JavaScript needed — and everything here is the same content a person sees on https://www.triplanio.com/.

## What it does

- Day-by-day plan — transfers, check-ins and plans lined up hour by hour, easy to scan, impossible to mix up.
- Your route on the map — cities, stays and transfers line up into one clear route, the whole trip at a glance.
- Budget on autopilot — booking prices land in the budget automatically; cash expenses take two taps to add. Any currency.
- Documents at hand — tickets, vouchers, passports and insurance live inside the trip, two taps away, even offline.
- Booking status — every item is either done or still waiting, so you always know what is left to arrange.
- AI booking recognition — forward an email, paste text or upload a PDF or a screenshot; dates, places, confirmation codes and prices are extracted automatically and the trip updates everywhere at once.
- Plan together — invite any number of companions into a trip; everyone works in the same space, uploads bookings and sees changes live, and the group chat includes the AI assistant.
- Telegram assistant — reminders before check-ins, departures and cancellation deadlines, answers about the itinerary with bookings, locations and files attached, and advice on the go, without switching apps mid-journey.
- Public share link — a read-only view of the trip opens in any browser, with no registration and no app install.

## Who it's for

- Solo traveller — a quiet command centre: every reservation, address and note exactly where you left it, with an AI that watches the deadlines.
- Trip for two — one shared plan instead of "I thought you booked it": both of you see everything, both can add anything.
- Group adventure — everyone plans in one space, uploads bookings, splits tasks and tracks the shared status.

## Pricing

Core planning is free, and no payment card is needed to start: trips, bookings, budget, documents and the timeline are all in the free plan. Advanced collaboration and the AI features are part of Pro.

- Pro, monthly — EUR 6.99 per month.
- Pro, yearly — EUR 39.99 per year.
- Pro for a single trip — EUR 8.99, one-time, unlocks Pro features for that one trip and does not renew.

Prices are per account (not per traveller in a trip) and are charged in euro. A subscription can be cancelled at any time from the account settings.

## FAQ

### Is Triplanio free to use?

Yes — start planning for free with all the core features: trips, bookings, budget, documents and the timeline. Advanced collaboration and AI features are part of the Pro plan.

### How does the AI booking recognition work?

Forward a confirmation email, paste text or upload a PDF or screenshot. The AI extracts dates, locations, confirmation codes and prices, then files a structured booking into the right trip — and updates your budget and readiness status automatically.

### Can my friends plan the trip with me?

Absolutely. Invite any number of companions into a trip. Everyone works in the same space, uploads bookings, sees changes live — and the group chat includes the AI assistant.

### Do people need an account to view my shared trip?

No. A public share link opens a read-only view of your trip in any browser — no registration, no app install.

### What can the Telegram assistant do?

It sends reminders about trip events, answers questions about your itinerary, shares booking details, locations and files, and gives general travel advice — all inside Telegram, no app needed mid-journey.

### Are my documents and data safe?

Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Documents are visible only to you and the companions you invite. Public links show the plan — never your personal documents.

## Languages

The interface and the marketing pages are available in English, Spanish and
Russian. The language is part of the address: English lives at the bare path,
Spanish and Russian under `/es/` and `/ru/`. Every page below is the same
content in the language its address names. The legal documents are English
only — they are legal instruments, edited as whole texts rather than
translated, so they have a single address each.
